basic_info.main_problem: 我在童年因为担心do not人会觉得我很蠢而停止戴眼镜,这种信念影响了我的自信和自我形象.随着时间推移问题持续存在,我仍因为害怕被评判而回避戴眼镜;在Social situations尤其是视力成为问题时,我感到not安全和Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: 我想建立自信,not再被这些Fear所束缚;我希望能舒适地戴上眼镜,而not再担心被评判.
growth_experiences: 童年开始戴眼镜后被同学取笑(如被贴上'戴眼镜=愚蠢'的标签),由此产生对被评判的Fear与羞耻感.为避免再次被羞辱,她在当时选择停止佩戴眼镜,并逐步形成'戴眼镜会让人觉得我很蠢'的观念.此后多年,这一经历Reinforcement了她在社交与被评价场景中的not安全感与Self-doubt.

core_beliefs: My value depends on others' evaluations

special_situations.event: 求职出版岗位的面试中,因为have not戴眼镜视力模糊
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人看到我看not清或戴眼镜,就会认为我很蠢,我not属于这个行业
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding wearing glasses,在面试中强行坚持not暴露视力问题,过度Self-monitoring以求not被挑剔
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定在评判我,觉得I am not good enough,not属于这里

special_situations.event: Interacting with others in everyday social settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我显得笨拙或暴露脆弱,do not人就会negate我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复Self-doubt与二次猜测,迎合他人期待以求被认可
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will look down on me; I need their recognition for it to count as okay

special_situations.event: Being teased by classmates for wearing glasses as a child
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 戴眼镜=显得愚蠢,do not人都会这么看我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately stops wearing glasses to avoid being humiliated again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只要戴眼镜,do not人就会觉得我很蠢

special_situations.event: 考虑是否向朋友或家人透露关于眼镜与被评判的具体not安
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我说出口,They will look down on me,觉得I am weak
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids disclosure, keeps a surface-normal appearance to avoid potential evaluation
